Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in West Chester for 2026, and here is what he found: 21 family events, at least 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Santa's Express at West Chester Railroad) through December 20, with the Christmas Tree Train (November 29, December 6 and 13), Santa at the Square (December 5), SantaFest at the American Helicopter Museum (December 12) and the Phoenixville Firebird Festival (December 12) along the way, plus the downtown caroling dates and the West Chester Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in West Chester

  • 21 Christmas events for kids in West Chester
  • At least 4 free events, including Santa at the Square, Caroling in Downtown West Chester, the West Chester Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting and the Coatesville Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the Square (December 5), Story Time with Santa at Bookmarks (December 9), SantaFest (December 12) and Santa's Express (November 27 to December 20)
  • Trains: Santa's Express (November 27, 28, 29, December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 20) and the Christmas Tree Train (November 29, December 6 and 13)
  • Parades and festivals: the West Chester Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting, the Coatesville Christmas Parade and the Phoenixville Firebird Festival (December 12)
  • Season: November 27 to December 20

Planning a bigger day out? West Chester families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Philadelphia, which covers the Christmas Village, LumiNature at the Philadelphia Zoo and the Holiday Garden Railway at Morris Arboretum.
